leads.title: AdaptaBrasil MCTI
leads.sourceEvidence: Official MCTI open-data catalog. Dataset: AdaptaBrasil MCTI climate-impact and vulnerability indicators for Brazil, with CSV downloads and municipal/spatial coverage. Format: CSV. Organization: Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation (MCTI), with INPE and RNP.

leads.title: Atlas Digital de Desastres no Brasil

resourceLinks.label: Official open data portal and downloadable disaster database

leads.sourceEvidence: Official MIDR/Sedec dataset portal. Dataset: Brazilian disaster occurrences, losses and impacts from 1991 to 2024, organized by municipality, state, disaster type and impact category. Format: interactive tables, maps and downloadable data.

leads.title: BDiA — Banco de Dados de Informações Ambientais

resourceLinks.label: Official IBGE data and export page

leads.sourceEvidence: Official IBGE environmental information database. Dataset: geospatial thematic collections for geology, geomorphology, soils and vegetation in Brazil, with spatial queries and export of graphical and tabular data. Format: geospatial and tabular downloads. Coverage: Brazil, compatible with 1:250,000 scale and updated through periodic revisions.

leads.title: Atlas da Vulnerabilidade Social — Ipea
leads.sourceEvidence: Official Ipea data platform. Dataset: social vulnerability and social exclusion indicators for municipalities, states and metropolitan regions in Brazil. Format: downloadable and queryable data in multiple formats. Coverage: Brazilian administrative and metropolitan areas.

leads.title: GeoInfo — Infraestrutura de Dados Espaciais da Embrapa
leads.sourceEvidence: Official Embrapa geospatial data infrastructure. Dataset catalog: geoinformation produced and curated by Embrapa for researchers, academics and the public, with spatial metadata and map layers. Format: geospatial data and catalog records. Coverage: Brazilian environmental and agricultural territories.

leads.title: SINISA — resultados e indicadores de saneamento
leads.sourceEvidence: Official Ministry of Cities SINISA results. Dataset: sanitation indicators for municipal management, water supply, sewage, solid waste and stormwater. Format: reports and spreadsheets. Coverage: Brazil, reference year 2024 in the 2025 collection.

leads.title: HydroSHEDS — core geospatial datasets
leads.sourceEvidence: Official HydroSHEDS dataset downloads. Dataset: global hydrographic and hydrological layers including elevation, flow direction, flow accumulation, basins, rivers and lakes. Format: raster and vector geospatial downloads. Coverage: global, with versioned products and documented limitations.

leads.title: SoilGrids — global gridded soil information
leads.sourceEvidence: Official ISRIC SoilGrids documentation. Dataset: global modeled soil-property maps at 250 m resolution and six standard depth intervals. Format: raster data and programmatic access. Coverage: global. License: CC BY 4.0; predictions and model uncertainty must be checked before editorial use.

leads.title: Global Surface Water — JRC data access
leads.sourceEvidence: Official JRC Global Surface Water access page. Dataset: global historical surface-water occurrence and change derived from Landsat observations, covering 1984 onward. Format: downloadable raster layers and Google Earth Engine access. Coverage: global.

leads.title: GHSL — Global Human Settlement Layer
leads.sourceEvidence: Official European Commission Joint Research Centre GHSL catalog. Dataset family: global built-up surface, population, settlement and urbanization layers from satellite imagery, census and volunteered geographic information. Format: downloadable geospatial layers. Coverage: global and multi-temporal.

leads.title: Global Migration Institute and Bridging Divides Journalism Fellowship
Programa de Bolsas Aborto em Pílulas — Gênero e Número
leads.sourceEvidence: Official Gênero e Número call. Fellowship: Programa de Bolsas Aborto em Pílulas; five projects receive R$5,000 each. Applications: 10–27 November 2026 at 23:59. Eligibility: journalists or communicators resident in Brazil, women cis/trans/travestis, trans men, transmasculine and non-binary people, with proven experience covering reproductive justice; individual or duo projects; active MEI or ME required for invoicing.
